fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Switch Lumen Shelf on or off for everyone.

fields.label: Restock from
fields.options:
Transfer first, then buy
Buy from supplier
Transfer from main warehouse
fields.description: Where a shortage in an outlet is filled from.

fields.label: Days of cover
fields.description: A suggestion buys or moves enough for this many days of sales, after the lead time.

fields.label: Safety level
fields.description: The higher it is, the more safety stock is kept for items whose sales swing.

fields.label: Supplier lead time (days)
fields.description: Used until a supplier has a Purchase Receipt against a Purchase Order. After that the lead time is learned from those receipts.

fields.label: Transfer lead time (days)
fields.description: Days for a transfer from another warehouse to reach the shelf.

fields.label: Weeks of sales history
fields.description: Recent weeks weigh more. Days an item was out of stock are left out.

fields.label: Suggest transfers between outlets
fields.description: Surplus in one outlet covers a shortage in another before anything is bought, and stock that does not sell in one outlet moves to where it sells.

fields.label: Days in stock needed before judging an outlet
fields.description: An outlet gives stock away, or counts as slow, only after it has had the item on the shelf for this many days.

fields.label: Show stock health
fields.description: Slow movers, overstock and the ABC ranking.

fields.label: Slow when stock lasts more than (days)
Overstock when stock lasts more than (days)
Adjust for seasons
fields.description: Learns from last year's sales of the same item in the same weeks. A season that sold more last year raises the suggestion before it starts.

fields.label: Seasons follow
fields.description: Gregorian for dates that repeat every year (school, year end). Hijri for Ramadan and Eid. Choose automatically uses the one that predicted your last 8 weeks best.

fields.label: Show rising and falling items
fields.description: Compares the recent half of the sales history with the earlier half.

fields.label: Show lost sales
fields.description: What an outlet would have sold on the days an item was out of stock.

fields.label: Plan purchases within a budget
fields.description: Adds a budget filter to Running low: the most urgent and most valuable purchases come first.

fields.label: Show forecast accuracy
fields.description: Compares what was forecast 14 days ago with what was sold since.

fields.label: Warehouse roles
fields.description: Optional. Every warehouse is an outlet unless named here. The main warehouse is found from the transfers it sends, unless one is named.
